runtime/unicode_normalization#

The native layer under unicode/normalization: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under unicode/normalization: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable Unicode 16.0.0 normalization boundary. A backend may use vendored tables, platform libraries or VM intrinsics, but NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD results must conform to Unicode 16.0.0. Applications should use the immutable Normalized value from unicode/normalization.

Public API#

native normalized_text#

native normalized_text(origin is string, form is string) is string

origin in form NFC, NFD, NFKC or NFKD.
